title: Welcome
content: The Kitchen Pot is a content site about kitchen organization and small-space cooking. We publish articles, guides, and product recommendations, and some of the links on our site are affiliate links. This policy explains what information we collect from visitors, how we use it, and the choices you have.

title: What We Collect
content:
We collect a limited amount of information from visitors to our site:

  • Contact form submissions: if you reach out to us through our contact form, we collect the name, email address, and message you provide.
  • Newsletter sign-ups: if you subscribe to our newsletter, we collect your email address so we can send you updates.
  • Analytics usage data: like most websites, we use analytics tools to understand how visitors use our site, such as which pages are viewed and how long visitors stay.
  • Cookies: small files stored in your browser that support site functionality, analytics, and affiliate tracking (see below).

title: How We Use Information
content:
We use the information we collect to:

  • Respond to messages sent through our contact form
  • Send newsletter updates to subscribers who have opted in
  • Understand how visitors use our site so we can improve our content
  • Keep our site secure and functioning properly

We do not sell your personal information.

title: Affiliate Links & Cookies
content:
The Kitchen Pot participates in the Amazon Associates Program and other affiliate marketing programs. This means we may earn a commission if you click a link on our site and make a purchase, at no additional cost to you.

When you click an affiliate link, the retailer (such as Amazon) may set a cookie in your browser to track that the referral came from our site. These third-party cookies are governed by the privacy policies of the respective retailers, not by us. We do not control how these companies use the data collected through their cookies.

title: Sharing Your Information
content:
We do not sell your personal information. We share information only in the following circumstances:

  • Netlify: our site is hosted on Netlify, which also processes submissions from our contact form.
  • Google Analytics: we use Google Analytics to understand site traffic and usage patterns.
  • Affiliate networks: when you click an affiliate link, the destination retailer may receive information about the referral, as described above.
  • Legal requirements: we may disclose information if required to do so by law or in response to valid legal requests.

title: Your Rights and Choices
content:
You have choices about the information we collect:

  • You can decline to use our contact form if you'd rather not share your name, email, or message with us.
  • You can unsubscribe from our newsletter at any time using the unsubscribe link in any email, or by contacting us directly.
  • You can control or disable cookies through your browser settings, including cookies used for analytics and affiliate tracking.
  • You can contact us to ask what information we hold about you or to request that it be deleted.

title: Data Security
content: We take reasonable steps to protect the information we collect, including relying on the security practices of our hosting provider (Netlify) for form submissions and site infrastructure. However, no method of transmission or storage over the internet is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

title: Children's Privacy
content: The Kitchen Pot is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us so we can remove it.

title: Policy Updates
content:
We may update this privacy policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.

Last Updated: September 2026

If you have any questions about this policy, please contact us at thekitchenpot8@gmail.com.
